items.exampleEn: He laughed explosively at the joke and nearly fell off his chair.
items.exampleZh: 他聽到那個笑話爆笑出聲，差點從椅子上摔下來。

items.exampleEn: A wizened old tree stood alone on the hill.
items.exampleZh: 一棵乾枯多皺的老樹孤零零地立在山丘上。

items.exampleEn: Our sales have not grown linearly; they jumped in some months and fell in others.
items.exampleZh: 我們的銷售額並不是線性成長，有幾個月暴增，有幾個月下滑。

items.exampleEn: Each of the three singers has a recognizably different style.
items.exampleZh: 這三位歌手各有明顯可辨的不同風格。

items.exampleEn: The news was received somberly by the whole team.
items.exampleZh: 整個團隊以沉重的心情接受了這個消息。

items.exampleEn: The blankness of the white walls made the room feel cold.
items.exampleZh: 一片空白的白牆讓房間感覺冷冰冰的。

items.exampleEn: The baby can now stand unassisted for a few seconds.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶現在能不靠扶持自己站幾秒鐘了。

items.exampleEn: Her hair was untangled and shiny after she brushed it.
items.exampleZh: 她梳過之後，頭髮不再打結，還很有光澤。

items.sentenceEn: The coach spoke somberly after the team's third loss in a row.
items.sentenceZh: 球隊連輸三場後，教練語氣沉重地發言。

items.audioEn: The new robot can clean the whole office floor unassisted.
items.audioZh: 新機器人可以獨力把整間辦公室的地板清乾淨。
options: Clean the office floor without help

items.sentenceEn: Ticket sales grew explosively after the film won a major award.
items.sentenceZh: 那部電影得了大獎之後，票房爆炸性地成長。

items.sentenceEn: The story is not told linearly, so pay close attention to the dates.
items.sentenceZh: 這個故事不是按時間順序講的，所以要特別注意日期。

items.stemEn: At the bottom of the box we found a few ____ apples, dry and covered in tiny lines.
items.stemZh: 我們在箱子底部發現幾顆乾癟起皺的蘋果，又乾又布滿細紋。

items.stemEn: The data shows that costs increase ____ with the number of users.
items.stemZh: 數據顯示，成本隨著使用者人數呈線性增加。

items.passageEn: Nora restores old photographs at the city museum. Her latest job was a picture of a market, taken in 1925, that had been badly damaged by water. At first she saw only blankness where the faces should have been. Working slowly with fairly rudimentary software, and largely unassisted, she rebuilt the image piece by piece. She did not work linearly from left to right; instead, she started with the clearest parts. After a month, the market was recognizably the same street that still exists today. A row of wizened apples sat on one stall, and a man in a dark coat stood somberly beside it. When the photo went on display, interest grew explosively online. Even the old frame, its wires finally untangled, was cleaned and kept.
items.passageZh: Nora 在市立博物館修復老照片。她最近的工作是一張 1925 年拍的市場照片，照片曾被水嚴重損壞。一開始，原本該是人臉的地方她只看到一片空白。她用相當陽春的軟體，幾乎獨力地慢慢工作，一塊一塊地把影像重建起來。她不是從左到右按順序修，而是從最清楚的部分開始。一個月後，照片上的市場已明顯看得出就是今天仍在的那條街。一個攤位上擺著一排乾癟起皺的蘋果，旁邊站著一位穿深色外套、神情嚴肅的男子。照片展出後，網路上的關注爆炸性地增加。就連那個舊相框，纏住的鐵絲也終於解開，清理乾淨後保留了下來。

questions.questionZh: Nora 是怎麼修復這張照片的？
options: 從左到右，一行一行地慢慢修
先從最清楚的部分開始
請三位同事分工一起修復

questions.questionZh: 照片展出後發生了什麼事？
options: 博物館決定把照片賣給收藏家
街上的老店主人來博物館道謝
網路上的關注快速暴增

items.promptZh: 這位登山者獨自一人、沒有任何協助就登上了山頂。
referenceEn: The climber reached the top of the mountain alone and unassisted.
Alone and unassisted, the climber made it to the top of the mountain.
rubricZh: 「沒有任何協助」用 unassisted，可放句尾或句首（例如 alone and unassisted）
「登上山頂」可寫，例如 reached the top、made it to the top 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 reached、made it）

items.promptZh: 聽到這個消息後，他的臉上只剩一片茫然。
referenceEn: After he heard the news, his face showed nothing but blankness.
When he heard the news, a blankness came over his face.
rubricZh: 「茫然」用名詞 blankness（例如 nothing but blankness、a blankness came over his face 等）
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 heard、showed 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
